profile.name: SPI串行接口控制模块
profile.description: 一个非物理的通用SPI串行通信控制组件，用于在实验电子系统中通过寄存器硬件层配置移位长度、重复次数、等待周期和外部触发，并读写发送/接收数据缓冲区。它更像是FPGA或底层电子学中的SPI传输控制单元，而不是独立实验仪器。
profile.description_en: A non-physical generic SPI serial communication control component used through a register-based hardware layer to configure shift length, repetition count, wait cycles, and external triggering, and to read/write transmit and receive data buffers in laboratory electronics. It appears to represent an SPI transfer control block in FPGA or low-level electronics rather than a standalone lab instrument.
